attackers_goals: Exfiltrate valid token and abuse it remotely.
description: An Azure Managed Identity token, which is attached to a compute service, was used externally of the cloud environment.
detector_tags: Cloud Serverless Function Credentials Theft Analytics
investigative_actions: Verify whether the Managed Identity should be used remotely. Check what API calls were executed by the Managed Identity. Check if the relevant compute service is compromised.
